intent: A pale quarry-stone set caked in dust white, cut in square blocks under a stepped dark slate helm, its pauldrons still holding the quarryman's iron wedges and a bone skull hung at the left hip, so from the high camera it reads as a pale-bodied, dark-headed stone warden.
reason: Charnel warden: a dark slate box helm over a pale, heavy body with a skull charm at the hip, the run's only funerary touch and its best fit on both bodies (7.2, second; first critic 4.6, sixth).
first_fix: Shape the box helm as a burial niche, whiten the body away from iron, and make one tool big enough to read.
